narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer reports that a French-born forward eligible for the Super Falcons has joined Chelsea on a professional deal. Soccer News states that Chelsea is planning a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Football London notes that Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice despite a promise from Xabi Alonso, while also reporting that a Chelsea wonderkid sent an 'awesome' message to Alonso.
narratives.headline: Chelsea transfer news and player profiles

narratives.body: London Evening Standard reports that Emi Martinez has confirmed her new aim following surgery and that the timeline for games she will miss after injury has been revealed. BeSoccer Livescore adds that Penders was handed a Chelsea opportunity following Martinez's injury.
narratives.headline: Emi Martinez injury and future plans

narratives.body: Daily Mirror and Football London report that Simon Jordan claims Chelsea are 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City, a statement that persists despite an 114-charge guilty verdict. CaughtOffside reports that a Chelsea player with 23 minutes of playing time this season has been urged to leave the club.
narratives.headline: Chelsea disciplinary claims and player retention
